places.name: The Vineyard Hotel
places.review: Peaceful, well located, lovely staff, food and gardens with turtles. Good fitness facilities and massage; uncomfortable mattress.

places.name: Kirstenbosch Botanical Garden
places.review: Beautiful plant varieties and some trails leading towards Table Mountain. Highly recommended.

places.name: Foxcroft
places.review: Excellent food, sunset views and outstanding mocktails. Lovely service, especially from Joshua.

places.name: Chapman’s Peak Drive
places.review: Stunning coastal views and white sandy beaches. Absolutely worth the drive.

places.name: Cape Point / Cape of Good Hope
places.review: A symbolic visit, with beautiful scenery and sightings of zebras, antelopes and ostriches. Nearly 30 minutes queuing and crowds around the lighthouse, but quieter beaches and scenic loops along Circular Drive.

places.name: Boulders Beach
places.review: Lovely penguin encounter, though they were moulting. Also spotted penguins outside the paid area; would prefer visiting outside moulting season.

places.name: Lucky Fish, Kalk Bay
places.review: Good fish and chips, but nothing exceptional about the restaurant itself. Nice line-up of fishers nearby. An optional stop, especially if looking for a more high-end experience.

places.name: Lion’s Head
places.review: Spectacular sunset hike, roughly an hour each way. Ladders and scrambling require reasonable fitness; bring water and a head torch, and stay near groups after dark.

places.name: V&A Waterfront
places.review: Pleasant for shopping, including luxury boutiques, but touristy and dominated by international brands.

places.name: Thompson
places.review: Excellent Chinese-inspired food, lovely service and a casual atmosphere with a great vibe. Highly recommended.

places.name: The Gin Bar
places.review: Good drinks in an intimate setting; quiet on Monday, probably livelier later in the week.

places.name: Hertz
places.review: Mediocre experience: booked car unavailable initially, with a 90-minute wait to exchange it.

places.name: La Petite Colombe
places.review: Lovely fine dining lunch with some exceptional dishes and impressive mocktails. Busier and less personal service than Foxcroft; allow 2½–3 hours.

places.name: Leeu Estates gardens
places.review: Beautiful grounds and sculptures, ideal for a stroll after lunch at La Petite Colombe, which is on the estate.

places.name: Babylonstoren
places.review: Impressive gardens, a lovely food shop and buffalo-milk ice cream. A brief visit shortly before closing, when we weren’t charged admission, felt like a good compromise.

places.name: Klein Champagne
places.review: Quiet boutique B&B with a very good homemade breakfast, a small pool and horses around the estate.

places.name: Tokara
places.review: Wines and olive oils didn’t particularly impress, but the cheese platter, views and estate walk were lovely. Felt more commercial than other estates, with one-hour tasting slots; the delicatessen menu looked promising.

places.name: Boschendal
places.review: Exceptional gift and food shop—one of the best we’ve seen. Pleasant gardens, though less impressive than others nearby.
